This is the official Blau Batch Corporate Identity Manual — the single authoritative reference for all brand decisions, visual design, and communications produced under the Blau Batch name. It covers our visual identity, colour system, typography, product portfolio, brand voice, and guidelines for every channel and medium where the brand appears.

Whether you are designing a product datasheet, building a presentation, producing a trade show exhibit, or onboarding a new team member — this manual defines how Blau Batch looks, sounds, and presents itself. Consistency is not a creative constraint. It is a competitive advantage.

Blau Batch has grown from a specialist filler masterbatch manufacturer into a full-spectrum masterbatch solutions supplier — combining our own in-house production with strategic distribution through Coraplast and growing technical partnerships with customers across MENA, Europe, and global markets. This evolution is reflected throughout this document.
Brand Overview & Positioning — our identity, values, vision, and mission. Read first.
Visual Identity System — logo usage, colour palette, and typography standards.
Product & Business — manufacturing capabilities, distribution, partnerships, and portfolio.
Operations & Reach — how we work, geographic coverage, and sustainability.
Brand Communication — voice, tone, stationery, digital presence, and photography.

This manual will be updated as Blau Batch's product range, geographic presence, partnerships, and visual identity develop. All brand approval requests and guideline updates should be directed to the Marketing & Operations Manager.

Blau Batch is an Egyptian masterbatch company that began as a filler masterbatch manufacturer — producing calcium carbonate-based compounds for plastics producers across MENA. Over time, the company expanded its portfolio by becoming an authorised distributor to Coraplast (www.coraplast.com), gaining access to a broader range of colour, additive, and specialty masterbatch grades.

Today, Blau Batch is evolving into a fully independent full-spectrum masterbatch solutions supplier — combining in-house manufacturing, strategic distribution partnerships, and customer-focused technical services under one brand. The result is a single source of reliable supply for plastics manufacturers across packaging, pipe, agriculture, textiles, and construction.

Our process is designed to move fast, remove friction, and ensure the right product reaches your production line on time and on spec. From the first enquiry to ongoing supply, every step is handled by our dedicated commercial and technical team.
Contact us with your application, base polymer, processing method, volume requirements, and any existing product specifications or samples.
Our technical team reviews your requirements and recommends the most suitable grade, loading level, and carrier system. We discuss processability, let-down ratio, and performance expectations.
We prepare and dispatch a sample quantity for your production trial. Samples come with a technical data sheet and certificate of analysis. Target turnaround: within days of enquiry confirmation.

You run the sample in your process. We provide technical support during the trial — advising on dosing, processing conditions, and any adjustments needed. Trial results reviewed and specification locked.
Volume, pricing, lead times, MOQ, and delivery terms agreed. We can work on spot orders, blanket purchase orders, or scheduled call-off arrangements depending on your volume.
Order placed, production scheduled, logistics coordinated. We provide proactive shipment notifications and full documentation: invoice, packing list, CoA, SDS, and certificate of origin.
Our relationship does not end at delivery. We provide continuous technical support, performance monitoring, and formulation updates as your process or market requirements evolve.

Blau Batch takes a measured and honest approach to sustainability. Rather than making broad claims, we focus on specific, verifiable actions and product choices that reduce the environmental footprint of our manufacturing and help our customers meet their own sustainability commitments.
Filler masterbatch reduces the volume of virgin polymer required per kilogram of finished product — directly lowering the carbon intensity of plastic production for our customers
Recyclability-compatible formulations available — no chlorinated carriers or heavy-metal pigments in standard grades
EU food-contact compliant grades produced to REACH and FDA standards — reducing compliance risk for customers exporting to regulated markets
No heavy-metal pigments (cadmium, chromate, lead) in our manufactured colour range for standard applications
Raw material sourcing from approved and traceable suppliers
In-process quality checks to minimise off-spec waste and rework
Production packaging using recyclable polypropylene bags
On-site waste segregation and responsible disposal of production off-cuts
Continuous improvement in energy and material efficiency as production volumes grow
High-fill filler grades reduce resin consumption per unit — enabling customers to reduce total polymer use
Carrier and additive systems designed for compatibility with mechanical recycling streams
Full SDS, TDS, and REACH compliance statements provided — supporting customer sustainability reporting
Custom formulation development available for bio-carrier, oxo-degradable, and recycled-content masterbatch on request

We do not claim to be a 'green' company.
